Direct official statements read: accounting/bookkeeping (OAC 710:65-19-28), advertising agencies (710:65-19-2; advertising sales in exempt media per 710:65-13-1), training (710:65-19-52(e), LR-10-143), data processing (710:65-19-86), digital design and marketing (LR-13-040). Advertising sold in media other than those 710:65-13-1 exempts (newspapers, periodicals, billboards, internet, broadcast) may be taxable under 1354(A)(11); not settled here.
